visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of a white desk. A 2025 May calendar, a cup of coffee with cream, and a pink planner are neatly arranged. A hand with silver glitter nails is partially visible resting on the table. (2) The camera transitions to a handheld shot as a person picks up the pink planner, titled '2025 藏老闆金句年曆'. The background reveals a bright, modern office with large glass windows overlooking a green landscape. (3) Several close-up shots show the interior of the calendar for months like April and July, featuring playful chili-themed illustrations and Chinese quotes. A hand flips through the pages to reveal the contents and layout. (4) A close-up focus is given to a sheet of small chili-shaped stickers with various expressions, held up against the calendar. The lighting is bright and uniform, emphasizing the product colors. (5) A hand holds up a plush red chili keychain accessory with green leaves and black sunglasses. The background is a clean white wall in an indoor environment. (6) The chili keychain is then shown attached to the handle of a white quilted luxury handbag, demonstrating how the product can be used as a charm. (7) A large, soft red chili-shaped plush pillow is displayed on a white sofa. A hand reaches out to touch and squeeze the fabric, demonstrating its softness and size. (8) A woman wearing a black beanie and beige sweater holds up a white speech bubble sign with promotional text, smiling warmly at the camera in a brightly lit indoor setting.

The vocal is highly resonant and bright, processed with commercial-grade clarity. The music maintains a constant high energy and BPM, providing a rhythmic bed for the visuals. (3) The rhythmic electronic beat continues as the vocals follow a melodic pop structure. There are no sound effects or incidental noises heard. The track is continuous without any audible edits or fragmented cuts. (4) The chorus of the K-Pop song continues with high arousal and positive valence. The frequency balance is skewed towards the upper-mid range, giving a sharp and energetic feel to the audio until the clip ends.
